high_level_description: The image features a person posing for the camera. The individual is wearing a white strapless dress that fits closely to their body, accentuating their figure. They have long, dark hair that cascades down their back. On their head, they are wearing a white headband with two plush, cartoonish ears attached, each adorned with a small blue dot on the forehead. The person is also wearing a light blue glove on one hand, which has a similar plush design as the ears on the headband, featuring a small blue dot on the palm.
